name: Yaps
summary: Voice tools that run on your own device: dictation into any app, transcription of audio and video files with SRT captions, read-aloud voices and voice notes. Free on Android, iPhone and iPad; the desktop apps for Windows, macOS and Linux need Yaps Pro.
best_for: writers, students and professionals who dictate or transcribe every day and want the speech processing on their own computer, across Windows, macOS and Linux
skip_if: you want a one-time purchase rather than a subscription, or you need a finished Windows version today
honest_knock: The desktop trial converts to a paid plan automatically, and the terms exclude refunds solely because you forgot to cancel; uninstalling the app does not cancel the subscription either. Windows is still labelled beta. 'On-device' has limits: signing in, billing, sync and model downloads use the internet, and on iPhone and iPad the system speech service can fall back to Apple's remote recognition.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Yaps Pro · per year, annual billing, shown as $12 a month, for the desktop apps
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-26 on yaps.ai/pricing with annual billing selected; the monthly price was read on 2026-10-16; dollar amounts, the page does not name the currency) Yaps is free on Android, iPhone and iPad: voice typing in other apps, voice notes with local search and read-aloud with 4 voices, without an account or card. Yaps Pro covers the desktop apps for Windows, macOS and Linux and costs $144 a year (shown as $12 a month) or $15 billed month to month. Pro adds unlimited dictation and read-aloud, unlimited transcription of audio and video files, SRT captions, speaker identification on Windows and macOS, chat with your notes, 18 voices, the Studio editor and vault sync. Desktop starts with a 7-day free trial that converts to the paid plan unless you cancel. Enterprise is priced on request. Students with a verified .edu address get 50% off the first year of annual Pro ($72), then the full price.
